description.value: Syros Pizza & Spaghetti is one of Kamloops' oldest restaurants, operating since the 1960s and beloved by locals for its halal pizza and Greek food. It offers both pickup and delivery, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists moving through the North Kamloops area. The menu spans freshly baked pizza to Greek fare, with an emphasis on quality ingredients.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is actively operating as a halal pizza and Greek food restaurant, one of the oldest in Kamloops (since the 1960s). The OSM address (125 Palm Street, V2B 8J6) conflicts with the website address (359 Tranquille Rd, V2B 3G4); the website value is used as it is clearly current. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
